notes.title: Meet the new Photo Editor 23!
notes.content:
[h3]Level up with the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2171300/Movavi_Photo_Editor_23/]Movavi Photo Editor 23[/url]![/h3]

[b]Get Movavi Photo Editor 23 at a discount if you already have Movavi Picverse on Steam - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28846/Upgrade_Movavi_Picverse_to_Movavi_Photo_Editor_23/]Bundle for Upgrade![/url][/b]

In the [b]upgraded Movavi Photo Editor 23[/b], we’ve added the features you’ve been asking us for: AI-driven portrait retouching, improved AI-powered photo colorization, refined AI-based tool to erase objects, new presets, and greater accessibility thanks to a redesigned user interface. Use them to maximize the quality of your images!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/bundles/28847/lpqrrq9thfygsodp/header_586x192.jpg?t=1667898996[/img]

notes.content:
[b]The main updates are:[/b]

[list]

Automatically select objects you want to erase and remove them from photos in just a couple of clicks. 

[*] [b]AI-driven image background removal[/b]
 Remove or change photo backgrounds with great precision thanks to artificial intelligence technology.

[b][*] Automatic photo enhancement[/b]Let artificial intelligence improve the light and color balance in images. You’ll love the fast, high-quality results.

Enjoy a seamless photo-editing experience.[/list]

notes.title: Hello friends!
notes.content:
[b]The main updates are:[/b]
[list]
[*] The ability to upload photos on Google Drive. Now your images don’t need to take up space on your hard drive

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1403800/extras/Google_RU.png?t=1637040797[/img]

[*] Photo manager: sort thousands of pictures on your computer. Create albums by name or category and detect people and places in your pictures
[*] Background removal is now smoother. No more poorly defined edges — cutting is done with pinpoint accuracy

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1403800/extras/Transparent_En.gif?t=1637040797[/img]

[*] Overlay pictures on other images and create collages from your favorite photos

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1403800/extras/Collage_En__1_.png?t=1637040797[/img]

[*] UI-enhancement of the Retouch tab: enhance portraits with even greater ease
[/list]
